note: Consignment (VOW Phase 4; vault 20-decisions 2026-10-06, prompts/build-vow-phase4-consign.md). Sources: Paul's Oct 5 texts and the 'Premier Consignment & Removal Program' PDF draft (vault raw/texts-2026-10-05). lawyer: true = powered vehicles under (or possibly under) Ontario's Motor Vehicle Dealers Act: shown only in review builds with a 'Lawyer to review' chip until the lawyer or VOW's OMVIC status clears them (vault 95 §1). Setting lawyer to false publishes the type; no code change needed. confirm = a fact Rae or Paul still has to confirm; hidden in production. Rae's Oct 8 answers (vault 96a §1.14–1.15, §3.8): VOW consigns all types (powered ones stay lawyer-gated), 20% commission, 8-month listing, owner clears liens first, VOW's prep repairs come out of the payout, onsite and offsite both offered. Payout timing and a separate account stay [confirm] for the lawyer.
lawyerNote: Selling motorhomes, motorcycles (and possibly ATVs and UTVs) for their owners may need OMVIC registration. Hidden on the real site until the lawyer or VOW's OMVIC status clears it (vault 95 §1)
costSentence: No upfront cost. Our commission and any costs you agree to (transport, removal, repairs) come out of the sale price, and they’re all written in your consignment agreement before anything is listed.

steps.title: Send us photos and details
steps.text: Photos of the unit and where it sits, plus a few details. The form below takes two minutes.

steps.title: We check for liens and the park’s rules
steps.text: We run a lien search (PPSA) and, for a park home, check what the park allows.

steps.title: You sign a written agreement
steps.text: It sets out the price, our commission, any costs you agree to, and when you’re paid, before anything is listed.

steps.title: We prep, photograph and advertise it
steps.text: We get it ready to show, take the photos and put it in front of buyers.

steps.title: It sells, and we pay you
steps.text: You get the sale price minus our commission and the costs in your agreement.

terms.label: When you’re paid
terms.text: Within a set number of days after the buyer’s payment clears, written in your agreement
terms.confirm: Payout timing: Rae wrote "90 days after the agreement is signed by the customer, which means the agreement is after the unit was purchased" (Oct 8). Unclear (after the sale? after signing?) and long; lawyer to set a fixed number of days after the buyer's funds clear (vault 95 §6)

terms.label: Other costs
terms.text: Repairs we do to get the unit ready for sale come out of your payout, with any other costs you agree to in writing first, like transport or removal

terms.label: Pick-up to our shop
terms.text: $6.50 per km plus HST, one way from where the unit is to our shop at 1841 Hwy 7. For units up to 8 ft wide and 42 ft long; bigger units are quoted

terms.label: Loans and liens
terms.text: You clear any loan or lien on the unit before we list it. We run a PPSA lien search to check

terms.label: Where it’s sold
terms.text: Your choice: where it sits (onsite), or we move it and sell it (offsite)

faq.a: No. Our commission and any costs you agree to (transport, removal, repairs) come out of the sale price, and they’re all written in your consignment agreement before anything is listed.
20% of the sale price. It’s written in your agreement before anything is listed.

faq.q: How long do you list it for?
faq.a: 8 months. It’s written in your agreement.
After the buyer’s payment clears. The number of days is written in your agreement.
faq.confirm: Payout timing for VOW consignments: Rae's "90 days after the agreement is signed" (Oct 8) is unclear; lawyer item

faq.q: Do repairs come out of what I get?
faq.a: Yes. If we repair the unit to get it ready for sale, that cost comes out of your payout. We agree it with you in writing first.

faq.q: Can you sell my park home where it sits?
faq.a: Yes. You choose: we sell it where it is (onsite), or we remove it and sell it offsite. We check the park’s rules first.

faq.q: What if there’s a loan or lien on it?
faq.a: You clear any loan or lien before we list the unit. We run a lien search to check.
